description: Create an Outlook folder (at the root or under a parent). Idempotent: if a folder with the same name already exists it is returned without error. Example: { name: "Newsletters" } or { name: "2025", parent: "Invoices" }.

name.description: Name of the folder to create

parent.description: Parent folder (name, path or id). Root if omitted.

name: mail_create_folder
title: Create folder
